meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: HyperFrames CLI dev loop. Use when running npx hyperframes init, add, catalog, capture, lint, validate, inspect, layout, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, render, publish, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, tts, or remove-background, or when troubleshooting the HyperFrames build/render environment. Entry point for AWS Lambda cloud rendering (`hyperframes lambda deploy / render / progress / destroy / policies / sites`).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行快速搭建和渲染 HyperFrames 项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在终端中管理 HyperFrames 项目的全生命周期。
copy.tagline_en: Manage HyperFrames projects from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage the full lifecycle of HyperFrames projects via CLI.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以运行 HyperFrames CLI 命令来创建、检查、预览和渲染视频项目，包括本地渲染和 AWS Lambda 云端渲染。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理视频项目，或提到“hyperframes”、“npx hyperframes”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 hyperframes 初始化一个视频项目。
say.note: 运行 npx hyperframes init 创建新项目。

say.text: 检查当前项目的 lint 和 validate。
say.note: 运行 lint 和 validate 命令检查错误。

say.text: 用 Lambda 云端渲染这个项目。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run HyperFrames CLI commands to scaffold, lint, validate, preview, and render video projects, including local rendering and AWS Lambda cloud rendering.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to work on a video project or mentions keywords like 'hyperframes' or 'npx hyperframes'.

say_en.text: Initialize a video project with hyperframes.
say_en.note: Runs npx hyperframes init to create a new project.

say_en.text: Run lint and validate on the current project.
say_en.note: Executes lint and validate commands to check for errors.

say_en.text: Render this project on Lambda cloud.
say_en.note: Runs hyperframes lambda render for cloud rendering.
